exceptions.reason: This string is a Docker --tmpfs mount specification for the disposable container /tmp, not a predictable host temporary-file creation.
Playwright intentionally listens on the development container interfaces to serve the configured Compose network; host publishing remains explicit in the consuming Compose configuration.
The uv cache lives only inside the isolated root-owned Docker build filesystem and is removed after installation; this is not a shared host temporary directory.
The /tmp string is malicious archive-link fixture data used to verify extraction rejects links escaping the selected workspace; it is never created as a temporary path.
The test deliberately exercises the sticky /tmp parent. tempfile.mkdtemp or TemporaryDirectory creates a unique private directory; cleanup is registered and the trust behavior is asserted.
